regime_context: China A-shares theme rotation is narrow and non-directional, led by Semiconductors (trend, not crowded) with AI Compute & Optics as a close challenger. The absolute-trend gate has not reduced drawdown historically here, so trend signals carry limited reliability; crowding is flagged only in Innovative Pharma & CXO. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics narratives.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics: observes whether this challenger overtakes Semiconductors to confirm a leadership handoff. Kill-criterion: Semiconductors remains leader and margin widens to >0.3 by 20 trading days, or AI Compute & Optics' score drops below 1.5.

theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the prevailing narrative, showing durable trend momentum (hurst_tag trend, durability 0.58), no crowding, and absolute eligibility.
